Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Bhupendra Singh
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1.
Short counter affidavit filed today by Sri Bhupendra Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Bhupendra Singh, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 12.4.2019,
cognizance order dated 23.4.2019 entire proceeding of Case No.2388 of 2023 (State vs. Rajeev)
under Sections- 420, 406 IPC, Police Station- Chilkana, District Saharanpur on the basis of compromise dated 26.6.2023.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Copy of the same is annexed as Annexure No.(4) to the present application.

sentences.text:
It is admitted in paragraph no.5 of short counter affidavit filed by learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 that the parties have entered into a compromise dated 26.6.2023.
6.
Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below and file a certified copy of this order within two weeks, along with the a copy of the compromise dated 26.6.2023.

It is,
therefore, expected that the court below may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of two months or till the final order passed on the compromise application by the court below whichever is earlier, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicant.
8. In case, the applicant is still aggrieved or if no action is taken, it will be open for the applicant to approach this Court afresh.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023/S.K.
